nodes.accessibleName: Larendell Larendell 271 games 70 reviews Recommended 47 hrs on record POSTED: 8 AUGUST Having finished both the single-player and co-op campaigns a couple of times each, I can safely say that Portal 2 is an extremely polished and simply brilliant experience in every single way. Everything from the tutorialisation and difficulty curve to the environments, story and humour has the level of polish that players have come to expect from Valve. After practising with Portal, which is practically just a prologue to Portal 2, they hit the nail on the head and made a puzzle game that's hard to surpass. There's not much to criticise or talk about that hasn't been said a thousand times at this point. One thing I will say is that while there's more achievements than in Portal, if you happen to have a co-op buddy, they're generally more fun and satisfying to complete compared to Portal's tedious Bronze/Silver/Gold ratings on the challenge maps. I just have to give a shout-out to the end credits song which – like the one in Portal – manages to be incredibly funny and emotional at the same time while also summarising the main events from the game. I occasionally have to go back and listen to them a couple of times to reminisce about Portal and Portal 2 with teary eyes while also smiling from ear to ear. All in all, Portal 2 is the golden standard for puzzle games and might be the point of comparison for the genre even decades after its release. Looking forward to replaying it once again in some number of years! 10 / 10 Read More Was this review helpful? Yes No Funny Award 7 people found this review helpful Plus One

nodes.accessibleName: T-T-TV T-T-TV 26 games 47 reviews Recommended 19,9 hrs on record (18,9 hrs at review time) POSTED: 21 AUGUST *SPOILERS* This game is the best story game anybody has or will ever play. It's so funny, cool, entertaining & story rich that I dont know where to start this review but I'll try my best. The Story is one of the strongest stories in any game I have played. You need some basic information from Portal 1 but when you know that stuff (& lets face it, you have probably played the first game & know that stuff) it's smooth sailing. It has a perfect mix of humor, gameplay & immersion. There arent many characters but the ones that are here are the best ones in any game ever. Wheatley & GLaDOS are so funny when they are at each others robotic throats the entire game. Speaking of GLaDOS, her character arc in this game is great. She is still the same evil robot from the last game but when she gets trapped in the potato battery and learns about Cave Johnson & her old life as Caroline she changes a little. When she gets into her old body again that stuff gets deleted but it's enough for her to let Chell leave Aperture. Now the ending is a cool one (with this game taking place 50.000 years after Portal 1) the world is different. You go into an open field which is a beautiful ending but when you think about the fact she (apart from the other frozen humans down in the lab) is the last human on earth. That is a deep ending & it fits the Portal series perfectly. I have more I would like to say but I'd be here all day & I dont got time for that when we got the amazing CO-OP campaign to talk about. The CO-OP is the funnest thing here. You get 6 levels with a bunch of chambers for you and your friend to complete together. I am not a big fan of CO-OP modes in single player games but this is the big exception to that rule. There is much more lore here and it's just a blast to play through with somebody, the only thing that sucks about it is the achievements. I am not a 100% achievement collector but for the people who are there are a lot of bs achievements here like my least favorite one "Friends list with benefits". You need to hug 3 people on your friends list so for that achievement you need 3 friends with Portal 2 & then hug them but the dumb thing is that sometimes you might need a 4th friend because my friend played with me and I would be his 3rd friend but the achievement didnt pop. I love this game so much and think it's one of the funnest games I have & will ever play so it's without a shadow of a doubt that I give this gem a 10 / 10 on the T-T-TV rating scale. Lastly, always remember that the cake is a lie & Cave Johnson will burn your house down with the damn lemons. ;) Read More Was this review helpful?
